exposure: Trophectoderm (TE) biopsy for preimplantation genetic testing (PGT)
cohort: 720 patients with singleton pregnancies from single frozen-thawed blastocyst transfer (FBT) cycles who delivered at the same university-affiliated hospital between January 2019 and March 2022.
finding: Trophectoderm biopsy for PGT is associated with higher risks of gestational hypertension and abnormal umbilical cord, but a lower risk of premature rupture of membranes, while neonatal outcomes were comparable between biopsied and unbiopsied embryos.
